velickovic.summary: Proves that when logits are bounded, every softmax coefficient of a global attention head decays as Θ(1/n) as the number of items grows (Lemma 2.1, Theorem 2.2), and proposes an ad-hoc adaptive temperature set from row entropy by a fitted degree-4 polynomial (Fig. 4).

barbero.summary: Argues that the first-token attention sink lets deep decoder Transformers limit over-mixing; measures strong-sink heads across Llama 3.1 8B, 70B and 405B (Table 1) and shows how pre-training packing and the ⟨bos⟩ token shape the sink (Table 2).

barron.summary: Names two numerical bugs in standard softmax and cross-entropy: Softmax Collapse, where the target gradient rounds to zero beyond a precision cliff, and Softmax Cancellation, a non-zero gradient when student and teacher logits are equal; gives log-space JAX fixes for both.

prieto.summary: Introduces the term Softmax Collapse for floating-point absorption that zeroes the loss and correct-class gradient in grokking tasks without regularisation, and proposes StableMax and ⊥Grad to avoid it.

gu.summary: Ablates pre-training factors and finds that attention sinks emerge after effective optimisation, behave like key biases, and do not emerge with unnormalised sigmoid attention in models up to 1B parameters.

streamingllm.summary: Shows that window attention fails once the initial tokens are evicted, and that keeping 4 initial 'attention sink' tokens plus a recent window restores stable generation over millions of tokens.

softpick.summary: Replaces softmax in attention with softpick, a rectified function whose weights need not sum to one; reports a 0% sink rate against 63.41% for matched 340M softmax models (Fig. 1).

gatedattn.summary: Adds a query-dependent sigmoid gate to the attention output; in its baseline comparison the average share of attention on the first token falls from 46.7% to 4.8% across layers.

gptoss.summary: OpenAI's model card for gpt-oss-120b and gpt-oss-20b: alternating banded-window (128 tokens) and dense attention, GQA with 8 KV heads, YaRN to 131,072 tokens, and a learned per-head bias in the softmax denominator (§2.2).

kvsink.summary: Studies how attention sinks interact with KV-cache quantisation; predicts sink tokens that can occur beyond the first positions and outperforms the Preserve-First-N strategy.

yarn.summary: Context-window extension for RoPE models combining 'NTK-by-parts' interpolation with an attention temperature, recommended as sqrt(1/t) = 0.1 ln(s) + 1 for a scale factor s (Eq. 15).

ssmax.summary: Proposes Scalable-Softmax, which multiplies attention logits by s·log n so the maximum weight does not fade as the input length n grows (Eq. 2).

fa4.summary: FlashAttention for Blackwell GPUs: a roofline in which the exponential unit and tensor cores are balanced for 128×128×128 tiles (Table 1); emulates part of exp2 on FMA units and skips online-softmax rescaling unless the running max grows by more than τ = 8 (§3.1.4).

bottleneck.summary: Shows that a softmax output layer over distributed embeddings is rank-limited (the softmax bottleneck) and proposes a Mixture of Softmaxes.

etalon.summary: Identifies pitfalls of TTFT, TBT, TPOT and normalised latency for evaluating LLM inference, and proposes fluidity-index, a deadline-based metric (§3.1, §4).

measbias.summary: Argues that single-process asyncio benchmark clients add client-side queueing that inflates TTFT and TPOT at high load, lists reproducibility anti-patterns (§4) and proposes a multi-process framework and the NTPOT metric.

vidur.summary: A simulator for LLM inference that predicts request latency from operator profiles; reports fidelity against real vLLM runs on static and dynamic traces (Figs. 3–4) and uses it for configuration search.

distserve.summary: Disaggregates prefill and decode onto separate GPUs and optimises goodput, defined as the maximum request rate served while meeting a TTFT/TPOT SLO-attainment goal (§1).

lmcache.summary: A KV-cache layer that offloads and shares KV caches across queries and engines (vLLM, SGLang), with evaluation scenarios in Table 4 and component-wise and sensitivity studies (§8).

mlenergy.summary: A benchmark and leaderboard for inference energy built on four stated design principles (§2), with measurements across 40 model architectures and 6 tasks.

lico.summary: Reproducibility study of the LICO interpretability method, organised as numbered claims tested one by one; the authors were mostly unable to reproduce the original results.

memctx.summary: Replicates and stress-tests a study of how language models arbitrate between memorised and in-context facts across 31 models in four families, confirming most original findings and reporting where they fail.

tailcache.summary: Tail-Optimized LRU for prompt caching: a two-line change to LRU with an optimality proof, reducing P90 TTFT by up to 27.5% and 200 ms SLO violations by up to 38.9% on WildChat.

sglang.title: SGLang: python/sglang/srt/layers/sampler.py, logits_processor.py; docs/advanced_features/server_arguments.mdx
sglang.summary: Read for how log-probabilities are computed: logits are cast to float32, greedy requests use log_softmax, standard sampling returns torch.log(probs), and --rl-on-policy-target computes log_softmax in bfloat16.

vllm.title: vLLM: vllm/v1/sample/sampler.py
vllm.summary: Read for compute_logprobs, which returns logits.log_softmax(dim=-1, dtype=torch.float32).

hftransformers.title: Hugging Face transformers: modelling code and the attention / mask interfaces
hftransformers.summary: Reference implementations used for the probes; eager attention computes softmax in float32 and adds the mask as a large negative finite value.

flashattn.title: flash-attention: flash_attn/cute/interface.py and softmax.py
flashattn.summary: Read for learnable_sink, folded into the softmax normaliser as one extra column with no value vector, and rescale_threshold = 8.0.

llama4code.title: llama-models: models/llama4/model.py, moe.py, args.py, MODEL_CARD.md
llama4code.summary: Reference code for Llama 4: on NoPE layers the query is scaled by 1 + 0.1·ln(floor((pos+1)/8192) + 1) ('attention temperature tuning'); router uses a sigmoid on the top-1 score.

softpickckpt.title: vanilla-340M-4096-model and softpick-340M-4096-model checkpoints (config.json, fla/ code)
softpickckpt.summary: The softpick authors' matched 340M softmax and softpick models (24 layers, 16 heads of dim 64, 32k Llama-2 vocabulary), used for the sink comparison.

v2report.title: Where Softmax Lives in Modern Models (technical report, version 2)
v2report.summary: Companion technical report: source-checked survey, census of 36 families, CPU reproductions E1–E5 with code and data.

sigmoidattn.summary: Studies sigmoid in place of softmax attention; proposes a bias b = −log n for sequence length n (App. E) and FlashSigmoid, reported 17% faster than FlashAttention-2 kernels on H100.

selective.summary: Selective Attention, a parameter-free change that reduces attention to unneeded context elements; reports quality equal to standard Transformers with about 2× more attention heads and parameters.

roundround.summary: Analyses how Gemma 7B uses RoPE and finds that it builds positional attention patterns from RoPE's highest frequencies.

glasses.summary: Proves a representational-collapse effect in decoder-only Transformers, in which distinct inputs give arbitrarily close final-token representations, worsened by low-precision formats; links it to over-squashing.

infini.summary: Infini-attention: adds a compressive linear-attention memory to softmax attention for unbounded context; evaluated on 1M-token passkey retrieval and 500K-token summarisation.

griffin.summary: Griffin: a hybrid of gated linear recurrences (RG-LRU) and local attention.

recurrentgemma.summary: RecurrentGemma technical report: Griffin architecture with a 2,048-token local attention window and a fixed-size state (Table 1).

gemma1.summary: Gemma technical report: the 7B model uses multi-head attention and the 2B model multi-query attention; 256k vocabulary.

gemma2.summary: Gemma 2 technical report: alternating local (4,096) and global (8,192) attention and logit soft-capping at 50 (attention) and 30 (final layer).

gemma3.summary: Gemma 3 technical report: 5:1 interleaving of local (1,024-token window) and global layers, 128K context, and QK-norm replacing Gemma 2's soft-capping.

qknorm.summary: Proposes normalising queries and keys before the dot product (QK-norm) with a learnable scale.

vit22b.summary: Scales a vision Transformer to 22B parameters with parallel layers, query/key (QK) normalisation and omitted biases, for efficiency and training stability.

palm.summary: PaLM technical report: uses multi-query attention and an auxiliary z-loss of 10⁻⁴·log²Z to keep the softmax normaliser log Z close to 0.

fa1.summary: FlashAttention: exact attention computed in tiles with an online softmax (running max and sum), never writing the attention matrix to memory.

gpt3.summary: GPT-3: 2,048-token context and alternating dense and locally banded sparse attention patterns (§2.1).

llama1.summary: LLaMA technical report: decoder-only models trained on public data; Table 1 of the Llama 2 report lists its 2k context.

llama2.summary: Llama 2 technical report: 4k context, a 32k-token vocabulary, and grouped-query attention for the 34B and 70B models (Table 1).

llama3.summary: The Llama 3 Herd of Models: grouped-query attention with 8 KV heads and an attention mask that blocks attention between documents in a sequence.

mistral.summary: Mistral 7B: grouped-query attention and sliding-window attention (window 4,096) with a rolling-buffer cache.

mixtral.summary: Mixtral of Experts: router G(x) = Softmax(TopK(x·W_g)) choosing 2 of 8 experts per token.

qwen2.summary: Qwen2 technical report: GQA with QKV bias; Dual Chunk Attention with YaRN for long context.

qwen3.summary: Qwen3 technical report: removes QKV bias and adds QK-norm; MoE models use 128 experts with 8 active and no shared experts.

phi3.summary: Phi-3 technical report: phi-3-mini has a 4K default context and a 128K LongRoPE variant; phi-3-small alternates dense and blocksparse attention layers.

olmo2.summary: OLMo 2 technical report: adopts QK-norm (RMSNorm on queries and keys) and z-loss regularisation for training stability.

falcon.summary: The Falcon series: multi-query attention (extended to multigroup for larger models) and a 65,024-token vocabulary.

glm45.summary: GLM-4.5 technical report: GQA with partial RoPE, QK-norm, and MoE with loss-free balance routing and sigmoid gates.

dsv2.summary: DeepSeek-V2 technical report: Multi-head Latent Attention (MLA) and DeepSeekMoE with device-limited routing.

dsv3.summary: DeepSeek-V3 technical report: MLA, sigmoid affinity scores normalised over the selected experts, auxiliary-loss-free load balancing; 37B activated parameters.

kimik2.summary: Kimi K2 technical report: an MLA-based MoE model trained with MuonClip, whose QK-Clip rescales query and key weights to bound attention logits.

mamba.summary: Mamba: a selective state-space model with no attention layers.

mamba2.summary: Mamba-2 and structured state-space duality (SSD), linking SSMs and linear attention.

jamba.summary: Jamba: interleaves attention and Mamba layers (1:7), uses MoE every other layer with 16 experts and top-2 routing, and no explicit positional encoding.

jamba15.summary: Jamba-1.5: hybrid Transformer-Mamba models at scale with a 256K context.

rwkv6.summary: Eagle and Finch: RWKV-5/6 with matrix-valued states and data-dependent recurrence; no softmax attention.

minimax.summary: MiniMax-01: one softmax-attention block after every seven lightning (linear) attention blocks, 32-expert MoE, 1M-token training context.

bert.summary: BERT: bidirectional Transformer encoder pre-trained with masked language modelling.

t5.summary: T5: encoder-decoder Transformer with relative position biases, framing all NLP tasks as text-to-text.

vit.summary: Vision Transformer: patches as tokens with a class token and bidirectional self-attention.

clip.summary: CLIP: contrastive image-text pre-training with a softmax over the batch's similarity matrix and a learned temperature.

siglip.summary: SigLIP: replaces CLIP's softmax contrastive loss with a pairwise sigmoid loss with learned temperature and bias.

whisper.summary: Whisper: an encoder-decoder speech recognition model with self- and cross-attention.

hfconfigs.title: Official config.json files for the 44 Hugging Face Hub repositories in sources/configs/
hfconfigs.summary: Model configurations read for the census: attention type, context length, vocabulary, experts, router function, RoPE scaling, soft-capping and window settings.

llamamodels.title: llama-models: models/llama4/model.py, moe.py, args.py, MODEL_CARD.md
llamamodels.summary: Reference code for Llama 4: on NoPE layers the query is scaled by 1 + 0.1·ln(floor((pos+1)/8192) + 1) ('attention temperature tuning'); router uses a sigmoid on the top-1 score.

cards.title: Model cards: Qwen/Qwen3-8B, CohereLabs/c4ai-command-r-v01, ai21labs/AI21-Jamba-1.5-Mini
cards.venue: Hugging Face Hub README files, read 2026-11-03
cards.summary: Read for context lengths and long-context settings (e.g. Qwen3: 32,768 native, 131,072 with YaRN factor 4).
